name: Bank CSV Statement Parser
description: Parse bank CSV statements and store transactions in Data Sheets (Example: Wise Bank)
explanation:
This workflow parses bank CSV statements, extracts transaction data, and stores it in Data Sheets.

Example: Wise Bank CSV
Format: Comma-separated, Date DD-MM-YYYY

Example CSV:
TransferWise ID,Date,Amount,Currency,Description,Running Balance
123456,12-09-2025,922.14,EUR,Payment from Client,1887.48
123457,01-09-2025,-8.92,EUR,Slack subscription,1005.51

How to use:
1. Download CSV from your bank
2. Upload the CSV file in the chat
3. Transactions are automatically parsed and saved

Customization:
This template uses Wise Bank CSV format as an example. You can customize the AI node's system prompt to support your bank's specific CSV format.

dataSheetSchema.name: Bank Transactions
dataSheetSchema.description: Parsed bank transaction data from CSV
